heading: Pulse: See what Windows is really doing Pulse is the Windows diagnost...
script_hook_excerpt: Pulse is the Windows diagnostic app that finally translates your computer's crash logs into plain English. Instead of staring at
description_first_lines: Pulse: See what Windows is really doing Pulse is the Windows diagnostic app that finally translates your computer’s crash logs into plain English. Instead of staring at cryptic error codes and XML files, it watches your system in real time and explains exactly what went wrong in simple sentences. It tells you if Windows restarted after a blue screen, if a specific driver failed, or if a power loss occurred, turning confusing technical noise into clear, readable insights. It also shows your CPU, memory, and disk usage in a live view, so you can see exactly what your machine is doing right now. Open source: https://github.com/regncreative/pulse #WindowsTips #PCHelp #BlueScreen

heading: xtool builds iOS apps without a Mac Repo: github.com/xtool-org/xtool ...
script_hook_excerpt: You need a Mac to build an iPhone app. X Tool is an open source tool that builds iOS apps
description_first_lines: xtool builds iOS apps without a Mac Repo: github.com/xtool-org/xtool xtool is an open-source tool that builds and installs iOS apps without a Mac. It signs them and installs them, all without Xcode, and runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows via WSL. On macOS, the README calls it a lighter alternative to Xcode. It builds a Swift package into a real iOS app, then talks to Apple's developer services directly, no Xcode needed. One command builds the project, another installs it on your iPhone. Needs: Apple's own Xcode installer file, plus WSL if you're on Windows. This and a lot more on our Telegram, link in profile. description_first_lines: DroidDeck runs Steam Big Picture on Android Repo: github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck Steam doesn't run natively on most Android handhelds. DroidDeck brings the whole SteamOS experience to Android instead, running Valve's own Steam client in Big Picture mode. Windows games launch through Valve's own ARM64 build of Proton. The newest update adds GOG, Epic and Amazon Games, with cloud saves for GOG and Epic. It even ships a full KDE desktop, with a Return to Gaming Mode. Up to 4 controllers connect at once for local co-op, and the built-in controller can act like a Steam Deck pad. PRoot itself got up to 57% faster in this update. Needs a supported Adreno GPU chip; performance still varies by device. Telegram: t.me/SkipCI #DroidDeck #SteamOS #Android #Proton #GOG #EpicGames #AmazonGames
